issues.message: Authority flood-exposure summaries are included. Detailed flood-extent geometries are not included.
HadUK-Grid rainfall files were not found.
Historical drought frequency and the all-zero motorised >2 hour healthcare measure have been removed from comparison choices. Original source files and authority values are retained for provenance.

display_note: Raster overlays are generalised for web display. Source resolution, date and coverage appear with each layer.

comparison_exclusions.drought_frequency: Removed from comparisons: authority values span only 6.12–7.34% of valid months in a 0.5° historical source (1901–2023). All fall in the same 5–10% map band.
comparison_exclusions.access_drive_gt120_pct: Removed from comparisons: all 296 authority values are 0.00% at this threshold. This does not establish current access or capacity.

archived_layers.title: Historical severe drought frequency
archived_layers.note: Months with six-month SPEI ≤ −1.5 divided by valid months. Native grid is 0.5°. Historical frequency, not current drought or a return-period hazard.
